name: Greater Whispering Campaign
body:
Your whispering campaigns are more believable and their effects last longer.

Prerequisite(s): Cha 15, Perform (oratory) 10 ranks, 5th-level chronicler

Benefit: The DC to resist the effects caused by your whispering campaign ability increases by 2. Additionally, you are considered to have 3 more levels of chronicler than you actually do for purposes of determining your caster level for these effects and their duration. Finally, once per week, you can choose to shift attitudes two steps instead of one step when you denounce or promote a particular target to others.
